_help: Settings for the anime edit generator. Lines starting with _help are explanations only. Text values need "double quotes"; every line except the last in a group ends with a comma. Unsafe values are clamped automatically (see the log).

edit._help: duration_seconds: length of the edit (ends on the nearest musical downbeat). music_file: "auto" = first song in music/, or a file name. music_start_seconds: "auto" = most energetic part incl. the drop, or a number. clip_order: "hybrid" = story order, but the drop and biggest hits get the best action moments; "chronological" = strict story order; "best_moments" = strongest action on the strongest beats. skip_start/end_seconds: ignore intros/credits of every clip. random_seed: change it to get a different variation of the same edit.

output._help: Final export. 1080x1920 = vertical 9:16 for TikTok/Shorts/Reels. fps: 60 (smoothest) or 30 (renders ~2x faster). framing: "smart_crop" (crop follows the action), "center_crop", "blur_fill" (whole picture on a blurred background), "fit" (black bars). video_crf: quality, lower = better/larger (16-22). x264_preset: "fast" renders quicker, "slow" compresses better. parallel_jobs: clips rendered at the same time (2-4).

draft._help: Used by preview_edit.py and create_edit.py --draft: low resolution so it renders fast.

preview._help: seconds: preview length. section: "drop" (around the biggest beat drop) or "start".

beats._help: cut_every_beats: base cut frequency (1 = every beat, 2 = every 2nd beat...). beat_sensitivity 0-1: higher = more beats count as hard hits (more cuts on hits, more shakes/zooms). adaptive_cuts: cut faster in loud parts and slower in quiet parts. min/max_clip_seconds: limits for one clip. bpm_override: null = automatic, or the song's BPM if detection is wrong.

effects._help: All intensities are 0 (off) to 1 (max). velocity = slow-motion on the beat then speed-up into the next cut. shake = impact camera shake. zoom = punch-in zooms on hits. glow = soft bloom on bright areas. flash = white flash on the biggest hits; limited by max_flashes_per_second (max 3, keep it low for viewers sensitive to flashing). transition_rate: share of hits that get a whip-blur / chromatic hit / zoom-snap accent. slowmo_smoothing: "none" or "blend" (frame blending, softer slow-motion). color_grade: anime_punch, super_saiyan_gold, ninja_orange, cold_night, natural, none. contrast/saturation multiply the grade, brightness is added (-0.5..0.5).

audio._help: target_lufs: loudness of the music (-14 suits TikTok/YouTube/Instagram; -16 is quieter). true_peak_db: peak ceiling, prevents clipping. output_gain_db: extra volume after normalisation (the limiter still prevents clipping). Fades in seconds.

analysis._help: Motion analysis resolution. Higher motion_fps is more precise but slower for long episodes.

paths._help: Folders are relative to this project folder. ffmpeg/ffprobe: "auto" = search tools/ffmpeg/bin then PATH, or a full path such as C:/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe
